_doc: QC hard-core recipes for gen_core_kit_qc.py (claude/qc-cores-1024). Closed views: physical/ref_tile/<kit>/views (closed geometry = LEF pin contract; plan pins files are QC-P6 provisional 'io' tables). spec from the closed record's source commit when the ref_tile spec is not in the tree. RTL = closed source (blob-identical at the closed commit) + the decision-13 reset patch.

rtl_patches.why: OWNER DECISION 13 hard-core reset contract: rst_n is a SYNCHRONOUS registered input at the data IO budget; the internal async 2-flop synchroniser (rl0/rl1 or rs0/rs1, async clear on rst_n) becomes a synchronous 2-stage relay of the same release depth (assertion synchronous, release cycle unchanged). Downstream flops keep their async clear from the relay output (timed recovery/removal).
edits:
reg rs0, rs1;   // QC-CORES kit patch (OWNER DECISION 13): synchronous 2-stage relay on the registered rst_n input
    always @(posedge ck)
        if (!rst_n) begin rs0<=1'b0;rs1<=1'b0;end
